authority_provenance.directive: After one explicit exact-scope approval, repaired pre-apply STOP_SAFE continuations must issue a fresh one-use request automatically without asking again.

admission_requires: the immediately preceding fresh request was atomically consumed and reached CONSUMED_STOP_SAFE_BEFORE_APPLY
exact cleanup restored the certification subject, controlled source and Admin Safe Mode OPEN
the last-responsible defect has a new tested commit, safe deploy and aligned truth/convergence proof
the next request has a new contract hash, request ID, Candidate, Packet, lease and transaction nonce
subject, source, target, condition, policy, topology, evidence cell and blast radius are unchanged
the blocker fingerprint has not recurred after its claimed repair
automatic_stop_conditions: same blocker fingerprint recurs after repair
any prior apply, user movement, rollback attempt, ambiguous state or cleanup failure
ordinary-customer subject or certification identity drift
source, target, condition, policy, topology, evidence-cell or blast-radius drift
active real customer recovery, incident, lease, restore operation or Safe Mode closure
rollback-failure injection, direct rollback invocation, Authority expansion or Runtime background enablement
the evidence cell closes, the action class freezes/demotes, or CPS selects a different frontier

semantics.standing_scope: repair continuation decision for this exact controlled experiment only
